dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge spline with multiple discrete discontinuities (notches) located in the medial and distal sections.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior contour rising at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15:1 ratio of maximum visible base width to vertical apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent irregular notches on the posterior margin; horizontal linear scarring on the lower lateral fin surface; a large, jagged-edged white depigmented patch at the anterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white-to-light-grey tonal gradient on the dorsal ridge extending posteriorly from the fin's trailing base.
